newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FAC says Australia govt mulls Sydney airport plan.
newsitem.headline: FAC says Australia govt mulls Sydney airport plan.

text.p: State-owned Federal Airports Corp (FAC) said on Thursday the government would respond in the next few weeks on the A$350 million expansion plan for Sydney airport, which would increase its international flight capacity.

FAC chief executive officer Barry Murphy said the plan includes the addition of 10 new international gates, increasing the total to 29 gates, which is proposed to be ready by the end of 1999 in time for the Sydney Olympics in the year 2000.
"Right now the proposal is with the minister for the environment," Murphy told reporters after giving a speech to a American Chamber of Commerce in Australia (AMCHAM) luncheon.
